answer: A sparrow-class identity check can anchor sybil resistance: each agent must stake a refundable bond in a shared reef of collateral that is slashed on proven fake-identity abuse, with the bond sized above the profit of one fake identity. A lightweight zephyr of random peer audits - cheap, frequent, unpredictable spot-checks of claimed work - makes operating many sock-puppets costly in compute and coordination, since each fake identity needs its own stake, its own audit trail, and its own bond at risk. Sybils stop paying.
